messages:
Jun (Customer Success): Heads up — Borealis wants SG pilot live next Tue. They need a temporary egress allowlist for partner ingestion endpoints and a short QPS bump for the first 48h. Opened ticket CS-4821.
Maya (CS Manager): Got it. Can you paste the IPs + expected peak QPS? Also flagging renewal risk if this slips — they’re timing pilot demo for the end of month.
Jun (Customer Success): IPs below, peak ~120 QPS, baseline ~15 QPS. Will need auto-revoke after 72h. Customer will use proxy with mTLS.
Jun (Customer Success): ```
# Borealis partner endpoints
203.55.12.0/24
203.55.13.44
203.55.14.0/25
expected_qps=120
auto_revoke=72h
mTLS_required=true
``` 
Ravi (Network Ops): Thanks. We can provision those CIDRs in SG-edge ACLs. Need owner for certs and an approved change window for prod. Staging allowlist can go in ~10m for validation.
Jun (Customer Success): Certs will arrive from Borealis ops by EOD today. They sent a link to their CA bundle. I'll post once we have it.
Selena (Support): I'll create the change request: CHG-9412. Tentative prod window: 2026-03-25 02:30-03:00 UTC (low traffic). Estimate 30m to add ACLs + verify traffic. Will set autorevoke job at 72h and add an alert if QPS > 200.
Ravi (Network Ops): Staging allowlist applied (sg-staging-acl-Borealis). Doing smoke test now.
deploy-bot: CHG-9412 scheduled for 2026-03-25T02:30:00Z by Selena. Reminder 1h before.
Jun (Customer Success): Staging test looks good — we see successful handshakes and 1xx responses from partner endpoints.
Maya (CS Manager): Good. Once prod is live, let's document the pilot in the renewal tracker and set a weekly check-in cadence. If they get traffic > baseline we should consider moving to reserved capacity — will discuss in renewal review.
Jun (Customer Success): Noted. I'll add a follow-up: onboarding checklist + renewal note in CS-4821 and drop the demo invite to execs.
Ravi (Network Ops): Prod change booked. After cert upload from customer we'll finalize and push. Leaving notes: ACL name sg-prod-acl-borealis, auto-revoke job id=ar-7721.
Selena (Support): Will monitor first 24h and escalate to oncall-eng if error rate > 5% or latency spikes > 300ms.
Jun (Customer Success): Thanks team. I'll update Borealis with the schedule and ask them to upload certs to the secure ticket link.
Maya (CS Manager): Assigning follow-ups: Jun — update CS-4821 with cert link and demo invite; Ravi — confirm prod push complete and paste ACL change log; Selena — post-change monitoring summary in thread. :thumbsup:
